en.title: Tracks of the Beast, Roar of Iron
en.premise: On a continent divided by racial boundaries, the railway is the sole lifeline—and a symbol of division. As conflicts over interests between races intensify, three unlikely companions are drawn together by fate: an aging wolf-beastman conductor, a fugitive cat-eared demi-human courier, and a dragon child who has lost their memories. Aboard the 'Final Train' bound for the continent's end, they must confront their pasts and make choices that will determine their survival.

zh.title: 兽牙之辙，钢铁之咆哮
zh.premise: 在种族界限分明的大陆上，铁道是唯一的生命线，同时也是分断的象征。在围绕利权的种族冲突日益激烈的局势下，一名年迈的狼兽人列车长、一名在逃的猫耳亚人搬运工，以及一只失去记忆的幼龙，这三位背景迥异的人们仿佛被命运指引一般，共同登上了一列火车。在开往大陆终点站的『最终列车』中，他们将面对各自的过去，并在生存的边缘做出抉择。
